create.name: Ten Shin – Tempio Zen di Napoli
create.bio:
Ten Shin – Cuore di Cielo Puro is a Soto Zen temple in the Fuorigrotta district of Naples, and presents itself as the only officially recognised Soto Zen temple in southern Italy. It grew out of Shobogendo Napoli, an itinerant group that Massimo Taiku Rossi and his wife Daniela Myoei Di Perna led for about ten years in Naples, Salerno and Caserta after their early training with Taiten Guareschi at Fudenji. From 2011 the couple followed Carlo Tetsugen Serra; the association took its present name in 2012, and a permanent hall opened on Via Terracina in 2015, consecrated that October by Tetsujyo Deguchi of Toshoji in Tokyo. Serra ordained Rossi as a Dharma teacher in 2022, and the pair lead the temple together within the Il Cerchio network.

Zazen is offered three times a week: an evening sitting for experienced practitioners, plus a weekday morning and another evening open to everyone. Members pay a monthly fee that also lets them sit at the other Il Cerchio centres. The temple houses the Bokushin Kai school of Japanese calligraphy founded by Norio Nagayama, where Myoei teaches shodō as a meditative art in monthly Sunday classes, and it has run haiku and sutra-copying (shakyō) courses as well as Buddhist weddings and funerals.

courses.title: Meditazione Zen
courses.description: Regular zazen at the Naples temple: Monday evenings for advanced sitters, Tuesday late mornings and Thursday evenings for all. Newcomers should contact the office first and arrive at least fifteen minutes before the start.

courses.title: Iscriviti al Tempio
courses.description: Membership of the Ten Shin sangha with a monthly fee, giving access to zazen in Naples and at the other centres in Tetsugen Serra's lineage. Joining for the year online includes the beginners' meditation course and a trial lesson each of shodō and haiku.

free_resources.title: Indicazioni per una buona pratica
free_resources.description: Practical guidance for a first visit: what to wear and bring, how the zendō works, keeping silence and joining in the cleaning, and the weekly practice times.

Teachers Massimo Taiku Rossi, Daniela Myoei Di Perna and calligraphy master Norio Nagayama are not on Spiritpedia; teachers file empty.
Scuola di Shodō: the 2026/2027 year began on 27 Sep 2026 (monthly Sundays to June 2027); listed undated as a repeating class, not as a dated course.
Videos are short (2–6 min) presentation and practice films from the temple's own channel; the channel has 27 videos in all.
Base: Naples. founded_year left null: association renamed Ten Shin in 2012, hall opened 2015, earlier group Shobogendo Napoli.
Home page and contact page give Via Terracina 429; OraZen's site gives 357. Only the city is used.
Regional: Naples / southern Italy, where Spiritpedia has few listings.
'Summer School Zen Path' links to masterzenpath.it, a separate site, not read.
left_out: L'Inchiostro nel Dharma 2025/2026 (Oct 2025–May 2026) and Haiku Zen 2024/2025: past course cycles.
Buddhist weddings, funerals and internships (tirocini): ceremonies/administration, not teaching items.
Videos: 'Consigli (pandemici) di lettura' (pandemic-framed), Chiara Ghidini talk (guest speaker), clips under 2 minutes and the fundraising appeal.
"Scuola di Shodō": the 2026/27 course began on 27 Sep 2026 (lead session, 12 Nov: dated courses that have started stay out)
